name: DLMC live-reserve sell pricing
summary: DLMCToken priced buys and sells from its live USDT reserve, so linked buys could transiently raise the price used by a subsequent sell and remove more USDT than the buys supplied.
notes: DLMCToken is a direct contract. Its runtime was absent in the preceding block and is byte-identical at deployment and immediately before the incident.

DLMCToken receives exactly 420,000 + 1,000,000 = 1,420,000 USDT and sends 1,646,119.118936329868440038 USDT in the sole campaign receipt, for gross victim depletion of 226,119.118936329868440038 USDT. Its archive USDT balance falls from 226,119.118936329868440044 to 0.000000000000000006, exactly the same net change; no unrelated same-block adjustment is required. Of the depleted amount, 3,558.897243107769423559 USDT repays financing and 222,560.221693222099016479 USDT reaches the profit receiver. The seed measured only the latter proceeds. DLMC minted or transferred in exchange for the two buys is consideration, not an additional victim asset. Later movement of proceeds or recovery is outside this exploit-time gross-loss boundary.
